next.reason: 1985: "The value must be greater than zero."; 2023: "If the value does not conform to these two rules, the EC-I-O-LINAGE exception condition is set to exist.". Meaning, page body and greater-than-zero rule are kept, but 2023 now defines a result for a nonconforming page size: an exception condition, then fixed LINAGE-COUNTER and continuation behavior.
